vulnerability_type: Owner Privilege Abuse - Excessive Transfer Fees

preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (deployer)
Victim users must hold MARSINU tokens they attempt to transfer

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setTaxFeePercent(50) and setLiquidityFeePercent(50) to set total transfer fees to 100%. When any user attempts to transfer tokens, the _getTValues function will calculate tTransferAmount = tAmount - tFee - tLiquidity = 0, meaning recipients receive nothing. The fees accumulate in the contract's reflection mechanism and marketing address, effectively locking all user funds. Users cannot bypass this as _isExcludedFromFee only applies to owner and contract address itself.
